transform.implementation: reuse fit_transform_features from frozen MLP diagnostic without alteration
transform.normalization: unchanged PyG NormalizeFeatures on the feature matrix
transform.scale: one scalar: sqrt(mean((raw_train - mean(raw_train, axis=0))**2)) / sqrt(mean((normalized_train - mean(normalized_train, axis=0))**2))
transform.centering: subtract normalized train column means from every node

resource_budget.execution: one local CUDA worker, all cells rerun
resource_budget.basis: observed 280-record preprocessing run took 1.305 summed unit-hours; third condition may train longer
resource_budget.scope_rule: complete fixed scope; no outcome-dependent expansion or favorable subset reporting

pairing: within each architecture, same raw data, original split, seed, training grid, runtime and device across all three newly trained inputs
inference: descriptive per-dataset per-architecture validation contrasts; composite transfer study, no population/test claim or universal optimization-only mechanism claim
